input_rationale.evolution: The additive lifecycle API follows existing scheduler ownership boundaries but has no upstream release history yet.
input_rationale.locality: Runtime changes are confined to the scheduler, engine, and rollout layers, with separate focused tests, benchmark tooling, and documentation.
input_rationale.tests: The complete local suite passed 624 tests with 103 environment-dependent skips; 71 focused tests passed on NVIDIA L20 GPU5.
input_rationale.failure: Inference entry points fail explicitly while released, external cache ownership is rejected, and repeated release/resume calls are idempotent.
input_rationale.contract: Implementation, tests, documentation, benchmark tooling, and raw L20 outputs are digest-bound, but the artifact is not sealed or maintainer-reviewed.
input_rationale.integration: Release and resume are exposed through InferenceScheduler, InferenceEngine, RolloutGenerator, and RolloutRunner.
input_rationale.interface: The additive release(), resume(), and runtime_released interfaces preserve existing behavior while the runtime is active.
input_rationale.lifecycle: Release drops scheduler-owned KV pages, task caches, executor workspaces, and graph state while retaining model weights and policy version; resume reconstructs the runtime.
input_rationale.buildtest: The full local test suite, Ruff formatting/import checks, and focused L20 GPU suite passed.
input_rationale.policy: No dependency is added, caller-owned caches are never silently discarded, and unsupported ownership fails closed.
input_rationale.attainment: The L20 probe reclaimed 95.96%, 98.95%, and 99.74% of scheduler-owned runtime memory at 2K, 8K, and 32K context capacities.
input_rationale.coverage: Three context capacities, batch four, five cycles per capacity, scheduler/engine/rollout tests, and policy-version retention are covered; CUDA Graph lifecycle and concurrent serving load are not.
input_rationale.retention: All fifteen release/resume cycles preserved exact greedy-output parity, and the full local regression suite passed.
input_rationale.family: The lifecycle boundary is shared by direct inference and trainer rollout paths, but the hardware benchmark uses the AstrAI 1B preset only.
input_rationale.compile: The lifecycle code introduces no compilation step and does not compile during timed release/resume operations.
input_rationale.replay: Each of the three L20 context capacities was measured over five release/resume cycles with raw per-cycle results checked in.
input_rationale.load: The hardware probe uses a real BF16 model and batch-four decode, but not a long-lived HTTP service or concurrent arrival distribution.
input_rationale.resource: Only the explicitly available GPU5 was used; all other users' GPU processes and containers were left untouched.
input_rationale.coldsteady: Repeated release and resume latency is reported, but CUDA Graph recapture and a long serving soak were deliberately excluded.
